overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not posting its July 20, 2011 notice in an all-hours conspicuous location, but ordered no further remedy because the Town now posts notices on its website.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's July 20, 2011 meeting notice, posted in the Town Clerk's office on July 18, was not conspicuously visible to the public at all hours.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of its July 20, 2011 meeting in a manner conspicuously visible to members of the public at all hours

allegations.summary: The letter reminds the Board that its response to the complaint reached the AG 27 business days after filing, beyond the 14-business-day deadline. This was a reminder, not a complaint allegation.
allegations.key_passage: Our office received notification and a response from the Board on August 26, 2011 — 27 business days after the complaint was originally filed.
